title: Member, State Board of Equalization, 3rd District
notes: Los Angeles County is entirely within BOE District 3 (SOS BOE district map lists District 3 = Los Angeles; BOE member page states the 3rd District covers all of Los Angeles County). The other three districts (1, 2, 4) do not include LA County. Both advancing candidates list Democratic party preference.
